claim: M1 is accepted and M2 Build Observatory is the sole active work.
negative_control: tools/human-review-index.py:a live row omitted from the generated view

claim: One registry classifies every public Make target, pre-commit stage, Docker stage, and analysis command.
negative_control: tools/build-observatory.py:a public Make target absent from the registry

claim: One `make observe` interface generates help, listings, runs, comparisons, subsets, and recording.
negative_control: tools/build-observatory.py:a documented example does not resolve

claim: Named `ONLY` and `SCENARIO` selection runs only the selected closure and cannot record partial results.
mutation_control: tools/gate-mutation-test.py:the automatic cold prime a cached selection needs

claim: The observation schema retains exact source, environment, cache, command, sample, graph, and history identity.
negative_control: tools/build-observatory.py:a summary pooling samples taken against different sources

claim: Cold, warm, cached, uncached, no-op, incremental, and bootstrap meanings are exact and non-overlapping.
negative_control: tools/build-observatory.py:a cold sample with no observed stage state was accepted
mutation_control: tools/gate-mutation-test.py:a cold claim needs evidence for it, not absent evidence against it

claim: Every cached sample retains its exact priming and isolated cache provenance.
negative_control: tools/build-observatory.py:a reused project cache naming no prime
mutation_control: tools/gate-mutation-test.py:a reused project cache must name a retained cold prime

claim: The complete canonical suite covers every important working-tree and staged pre-commit use case.
negative_control: tools/build-observatory.py:a reused project cache naming a prime nothing retains

claim: Mutating and repository-configuration commands run only in disposable or isolated environments.
negative_control: tools/build-observatory.py:a mutating command run in the source tree

claim: The permanent command-surface validator fails on missing targets, stages, anchors, or classifications.
negative_control: tools/build-observatory.py:a pre-commit anchor absent from the registry

claim: Per-module timing, the Dune graph, critical path, and downstream rebuild sets are reproducible.
negative_control: tools/build-observatory.py:a dependency output with no module edges

claim: Git edit frequency, co-change, common edit shapes, and weighted rebuild cost use an exact retained range.
negative_control: tools/build-observatory.py:overlapping sample ranges refuse a verdict

claim: Local ad hoc bundles and the one tracked canonical observation use the same schema and implementation.
negative_control: tools/build-observatory.py:a bundle path that already exists

claim: Git-ref and local-path comparison reports exact deltas, ranges, compatibility, and added or removed metrics.
negative_control: tools/build-observatory.py:comparing against a run that never finished

claim: Recording requires a complete clean committed run and changes only the canonical observation file.
negative_control: tools/build-observatory.py:recording which changes a second tracked file

claim: Measurement anchors and wrappers preserve normal command order, bytes, output, exit status, and side effects.
negative_control: tools/build-observatory.py:a hook anchor with no timestamp

negative_control: tools/build-observatory.py:a selected command with no sample and no reason was accepted
mutation_control: tools/gate-mutation-test.py:a selected command that measured nothing must say so

claim: Proofs, theorem surfaces, extraction, transport, generated Go, goldens, and runtime behavior remain unchanged.
mutation_control: tools/gate-mutation-test.py:the cache vocabulary checked at load

claim: One exact M2 candidate carries the permanent facility and one canonical observation for that candidate.
